title: 为 Weekly Radar 提供可验证的 Telegram 测试边界
rawUserRequest: 开WI对应；走完WI，触发一次再看看；确认按明确重新发送现有报告的设计执行。

acceptance: The default same-date manual or scheduled workflow remains a successful ALREADY-PUBLISHED no-op: it verifies the final report/snapshot/receipt/manifest and performs no Telegram or data-branch write.

A distinct --republish-published-as-of path reconstructs the committed report from its input snapshot, sends it only when explicitly selected, and never writes data, receipt, manifest, or pending refs.
The workflow exposes the republish path only as an explicit workflow_dispatch input and rejects it for schedule events, dry-run, and incompatible recovery options.
The republish result reports only non-secret report identity, message IDs, and attempts; it does not claim that provider acceptance proves human-client display.
Automated tests cover default idempotency, option validation, explicit republish behavior, archive immutability, and workflow guards.
User-facing documentation explains the normal ALREADY-PUBLISHED result and the explicit republish operation, including its duplicate-message side effect and limits.
The later real event=schedule cadence validation remains separate and is not claimed complete by this Work Item.
guidelines: The normal publication path must remain idempotent and fail closed on incomplete or conflicting archive evidence.
Any new operator-visible mode must be explicitly named, confirmed, documented for users, and covered by tests for invalid combinations and partial delivery.
Never expose or persist Telegram Secret values; record only non-secret receipt and run identity evidence.
Keep system reference and human judgment independent; do not describe provider acceptance as proof of human agreement or client display.

intent.problem: A manual run for an already published date correctly returned ALREADY-PUBLISHED and sent no new Telegram message, so it cannot be used to prove a human-visible Telegram report. The existing receipt shows provider message IDs from an earlier publication, but does not prove that the intended human client displayed or notified the message. Separately, the cadence validation Work Item remains active on a retained closed-PR branch and must not be silently absorbed into this delivery-mode change.
constraints: Preserve same-date idempotency and never send a duplicate production report implicitly.
Do not expose or store Secret values and do not hand-edit data or pending refs.
Keep the real schedule cadence gate in wi-production-provider-e2e-cadence.
Treat provider receipt evidence and human-client display as different claims.
Keep the republish path explicit and limited to the one authorized post-merge manual validation run.
intent.rationale: The user confirmed that receiving the actual report is the required check. An explicit republish path is the smallest observable operation that reuses the committed report input without weakening the normal same-date no-op or mutating the protected archive.
